summary.text: Phil Shepard is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 15 in Onslow County who has served since 2011 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as retired civil service and minister.

paragraphs.text: Shepard graduated from Jacksonville Senior High in 1973 and attended Coastal Carolina Community College, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes 36 years at the Traffic Management Office at Camp Lejeune and 12 years as pastor of Lighthouse Baptist Church.
Ballotpedia says he lives in Jacksonville, North Carolina.

Shepard chairs the House Transportation Committee, the Appropriations Subcommittee on Transportation and the House Select Committee on North Carolina's Transportation Future, and he is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee.
He co-chairs the Joint Legislative Transportation Oversight Committee.
